original_failure: EOFError: read_str out of bounds (via tools/mb_dump.py, TypeTreeGeneratorAPI-generated nodes)

root_cause.summary: Same bug as T020/CLASS/22379dfdf824449b (PWC.Inventory.InventoryBuildData): TypeTreeGeneratorAPI labels the ROOT node of List<String> fields with m_Type="string" instead of "vector", keeping the correct Array/size/data children underneath but causing UnityPy's reader to treat the field as a scalar string.
root_cause.affected_fields_here: flagsToSkins.packs[].spines[].skins (List<String>) - the per-SpineType skin-name list inside each fashion pack's flag entry.
root_cause.mechanism: Identical dispatch bug: UnityPy.helpers.TypeTreeHelper.read_value() picks FUNCTION_READ_MAP["string"] = read_aligned_string for the mislabeled node, ignoring its real Array children, desyncing every field that follows.
root_cause.distinguishing_signal: Same as the InventoryBuildData case: the mislabeled node's first child is named "Array" whose own "data" child has m_Type=="string" (list of strings), not "char" (a real scalar string).

fix.location: tools/mb_dump.py, function fix_mislabeled_vectors(nodes) - same fix, no class-specific change needed; the function is generic over any List<String> field.

Pack.spines.SpineTypeToSkins.skins: List<String> - THIS was the mislabeled field

note_on_moda_pipeline: This class is NOT the data source used for the already-shipped Moda pack content in docs/STORE_BUNDLE_CONTENTS.md - that pipeline reads a CSV TextAsset (InventorySkinsBuildData.MAP_CSV_PATH = "AvatarMaker/Data/Avatar_MKR_Packs") via tools/pack_texture_coverage.py, bypassing this ScriptableObject's own serialized fields entirely. Fixing this class's decoding is still useful as an independent cross-check / second source for the same flag->skins mapping, and for provenance completeness of out/mb/_stats.json.

validation.result: Passes exactly for both instances of this class in the game (byte_size 41604 and 372 respectively).
